title: Ancient Probe
next_chapter_hook: "Within the shadow of ancient will, a truth sealed by dust is awakening—Tianji Record is both a shackle and a key, and the blood flowing through your veins is precisely the first key to open the cage of destiny."

text.content: "The moment that blurry coordinate exploded in his mind, Chen Ji violently opened his eyes—that was the direction of the depths of the Holy Sect, and his sister was there. However, in the next instant, an icy cold aura swallowed him whole. It was not spiritual suppression, but rather some ancient, primeval existence scrutinizing him with an almost instinctive approach."

"He found himself suspended in a void, with no distinction between heaven and earth, only endless darkness surging like a tide. Occasionally, star-like points of light would streak past, only to vanish in an instant. And in the deepest reaches of that darkness, a pair of eyes was slowly opening. Those pupils reflected vicissitudes and deathly silence, as if they had witnessed countless eons' cycles."

dialogue.content: "'...Chen family's bloodline? Interesting. How many years has it been, since the embers of this lineage dared step into my domain.' The voice was ancient and hoarse, each word as if torn with great difficulty from deep slumber, yet carrying undeniable pressure."

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart rang every alarm. What had he triggered to make this existence that even Tianji Record could only glimpse fragments of deign to speak? More importantly, the 'Chen family bloodline' mentioned—this meant the blood flowing through him was far more special than he knew."

choice.prompt: "The ancient existence's probe has arrived, filled with scrutiny of the Chen family bloodline. Faced with pressure and truths beyond comprehension, Chen Ji must respond—"

choices.description: "Respond with neither servility nor arrogance, first probe the other's depths before making plans. The more dangerous the situation, the more one must remain calm—this was the instinct he had cultivated from being atrash to orchestrating the world."
choices.risk_hint: "If the other party grows impatient, they may strike directly"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suppressed the surging tempest in his heart, his face calm as he clasped his hands: 'Junior Chen Ji, trespassing into this place by accident. I know not Your Excellency's honored title. If I have given offense, I humbly ask for forgiveness.'"

text.content: "His voice echoed in the void without a trace of trembling. This composure made those ancient eyes narrow slightly, as if gaining a bit of interest."

choices.description: "Since the other party has already revealed the bloodline matter, continued pretense is meaningless. Better to lay cards on the table and see what they truly want."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji's gaze fixed directly on those giant eyes as he said: 'Since Your Excellency recognizes the Chen family bloodline, surely you know its intricacies. This junior dares to ask—what being are you, and why do you concern yourself so with the Chen family?'"

text.content: "As the words fell, the temperature in the void dropped several degrees. Those eyes blinked, and within them emerged a trace of bizarre amusement."

dialogue.content: "The voice fell silent for a moment, then let out a low sigh: 'The Chen family... how many years. My name is Zhuyin, once the guardian spirit beast of Tianji Record's first master.' The words paused, as if even speaking this name required immense strength, 'Later... the master fell, Tianji Record fell into the mortal world, and I was sealed here, guarding those fragmentary memories, until this day.'"

text.content: "Guardian spirit beast! The first master of Tianji Record! A thunderous explosion occurred in Chen Ji's mind. Tianji Record had circulated in the world for countless ages, and he had always thought it merely a cultivation technique left behind by some great being, never once imagining it had such a special master—and now, that master's guardian spirit beast was speaking with him."

"What chilled him even more was hearing 'master fell'—the first master of Tianji Record was actually dead? So what exactly was this so-called guardian spirit beast's current state? A remnant soul? An obsession? Or some even more terrifying mutation?"

dialogue.content: "'You carry the master's aura.' Zhuyin's voice suddenly grew complex, carrying traces of reminiscence and doubt, 'Though faint, that bloodline's imprint... cannot be mistaken. Who exactly are you? Why do you possess Chen Xuan's inheritance?'"

choice.prompt: "Zhuyin's questioning struck at the core—Chen Xuan's inheritance. Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond to this question touching upon the secrets of his origins."

choices.description: "Since the other party knows of Chen Xuan and mentions bloodline inheritance, continued concealment is meaningless. Be frank instead, and see if you can exchange it for more truth."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party's stance is unclear, risk unpredictable"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji contemplated briefly, then slowly said: 'Chen Xuan... that is our ancestor's honored name. This junior is merely a collateral descendant of the Qingzhou branch, orphaned since childhood, knowing little of ancestral affairs.' He paused, 'Just now, Your Excellency said the master fell—may I ask the cause?'"

text.content: "He skillfully redirected the topic toward the mystery of Chen Xuan's fall, showing sincerity while attempting to gain more information."

choices.text: "Ask the other party why they were sealed"
choices.description: "Since the other party wishes to probe, he need not rush to reveal everything. Instead, probe this 'guardian spirit beast' in return."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may turn hostile in dissatisfaction"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji smiled faintly, answered with a question: 'Since Your Excellency is the first master's guardian spirit beast, you should have served by their side. Yet now you are trapped in this place, sealed for countless years... This junior dares to ask—who possessed the ability to seal Your Excellency? And for what purpose?'"

text.content: "These words carried a probing sharpness, yet also highlighted a crucial question—the existence capable of sealing a guardian spirit beast was by no means ordinary."
"As the words fell, the void violently trembled. Those ancient eyes flashed with pain and fury, quickly suppressed by some force. Zhuyin let out a low roar that shook the entire space."

dialogue.content: "'What sealed me... was Heavenly Dao!' Zhuyin's voice became distorted and mad, yet carried boundless sorrow, 'The master glimpsed forbidden knowledge that should not have been seen, broke rules that should not have been broken. Thus Heavenly Dao sent Heavenly Punishment, seeking to exterminate the master's bloodline root and branch! And I... failed to protect my master, could only watch helplessly as the master fell, as Tianji Record shattered and scattered!'"

text.content: "Heavenly Dao! Again Heavenly Dao! Chen Ji's heart surged with enormous waves. Mo Xiansheng had mentioned the existence of Heavenly Dao, hinting at some secret connection between Tianji Record and Heavenly Dao. Now Zhuyin personally confirmed this—the first master's fall was Heavenly Dao's punishment! What then of himself? What did the Tianji Record fragment within him signify?"

dialogue.content: "At this moment, Zhuyin's voice suddenly grew clear, the madness in those eyes receding somewhat, replaced by a complex scrutiny: 'You carry the aura of Tianji Record... no, it would be more accurate to say Tianji Record has already recognized you as master. But be careful—Tianji Record is shackle and key. It lets you glimpse Heavenly Secrets, yet also makes you a thorn in Heavenly Dao's eye.'"

text.content: "Shackle and key... these words echoed in Chen Ji's heart. Tianji Record granted him the ability to foresee the future, yet it had cost him the price of Heavenly Fate Value. Now he understood—this was not merely a 'technique' but a curse from Heavenly Dao—or perhaps, a trial."

choice.prompt: "Zhuyin's words contained astonishing truths, and that reason seemed to be fading rapidly. Before the ancient spirit beast fell into chaos again, Chen Ji needed to make a final choice."

choices.text: "Question the details of Heavenly Dao's taboo"
choices.description: "Since we've already touched the core truth, go a step further and find out exactly what the first master glimpsed."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji stepped forward urgently: 'Your Excellency, what exactly did the first master glimpse that was taboo? Why does Heavenly Dao pursue extermination so relentlessly?'"

text.content: "Before the words finished, the void suddenly collapsed, a terrifying force hurling Chen Ji entire body backward. He felt his chest tighten, blood nearly gushing from his mouth."

choices.description: "Since the other party is a guardian spirit beast, perhaps they can offer advice on surviving under Heavenly Dao's gaze."
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may already be powerless to help"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji steadied himself, clasped his hands and said: 'Since Your Excellency knows the dangers within, may I ask for instruction? How can one carve out a path of survival under Heavenly Dao's watch?'"

text.content: "His tone was sincere—it was the first time since rising fromtrash that he truly sought counsel from another. The path ahead was too perilous; he needed every assistance he could obtain."

dialogue.content: "Those eyes' reason was rapidly fading, but before completely succumbing to chaos, Zhuyin's voice sounded one last time: 'Seek... the complete... key... at destiny's end... there is a person... waiting for you...' The voice grew increasingly vague, finally dissipating into endless darkness."

text.content: "Chen Ji jolted awake, finding himself still lying in the ruins outside the Holy Sect. Around him were familiar ruins and broken walls, the void space just now seemingly merely an illusion. But in his mind, those ancient eyes remained vividly clear, and those words were etched as deeply as knife-carved marks."

"Shackle and key... Chen Xuan's inheritance... Heavenly Dao's punishment... these fragments constantly reorganized in his mind, faintly outlining an astonishing silhouette. Tianji Record was not merely a cultivation technique, but something far more terrifying—it was both a piece Heavenly Dao had positioned on the board, and potentially the key to breaking destiny. And he, Chen Ji, had unmistakably placed himself at the center of this chess game."

"At this moment, the jade slip at his chest grew warm—that was the contact method left by Mo Xiansheng. The voice of the remnant soul guardian rang in his mind, carrying a weighty tone: 'Master, your刚才的气息fluctuation很大，发生了什么？' Chen Ji沉默了片刻，随即将方才的经历简要述说了一遍。通讯那头沉默了许久，墨先生的声音才再次响起：'烛阴……原来它还活着。主人，您知道这意味着什么吗？天机录的初代主人，是唯一一个曾经完整掌控天机录的存在。而他的护道灵兽，如今仍在世间……这其中的因果，远比您想象的更加complex。不过既然它提到了'钥匙'和'命运的终点'，那说明您走的方向是对的。继续前进吧，主人。命运的棋局已经展开，而您要做的，就是成为那个打破棋盘的人。'"
